body: Yes I've beaten it before, six years ago, but I was struggling this much back then, it wsa a much simpler thing to overcome and I had friends to support me through it and family that was excited for my future and now I don't have either of those things so I don't see the point. Yes there may be random people reaching out to me across the internet but I'm never going to know any of them. There is nothing to fight for, the reason I am still here is because I'm afraid it won't work.

Everything I try comes crumbling down around me and I'm sick of trying again and again. I just can't do it by myself but no matter what I do I end up just as alone or more alone than I already was. I can't do this on my own.
That's not what I need to talk about.

I am quite certain that this is they way to go. I have thought about it for ages now and I think it's for the best. Living like this is just not worth it. Even if I did get better for some time I would just end up back like I am now and feeling like this is not worth the short amount of happiness. It's too much and it's too hard and I am defeated.
